records.issue_text: applyTemplateVariables is applied twice with the same request.filters (once in shardQuerySplitting.ts/querySplitting.ts and again in DataSourceWithBackend.query via runQuery), causing addAdHocFilters to append ad-hoc filter label matchers to the LogQL stream selector twice

The 'Interpolates queries before execution' tests in querySplitting.test.ts and shardQuerySplitting.test.ts stub replace with a naive string replace, asserting $__auto → 5m behaviour that production applyTemplateVariables deliberately does not produce (it strips __auto/__interval/__range for backend resolution), giving false confidence

The applyTemplateVariables mocks in shardQuerySplitting.test.ts mutate query.expr in place and return the same object, unlike the real implementation, which combined with the shared request fixture masks bugs where split code relies on request.targets being unmodified
records.rationale: In shardQuerySplitting.test.ts the mocked datasource.applyTemplateVariables implementations directly mutate the passed LokiQuery object (e.g. `query.expr = query.expr.replace(...)`) and return the same object.
